title: MacArthur Park Perimeter Fencing Project Presentation to RAP Board
text:
[MacArthur Park Perimeter Fencing Project Presentation to RAP Board]
REVISED

MacArthur Park Fencing Project

  RAP Board Meeting
  October 1, 2026

Project Location

❖ MacArthur Park
❖ Council District 1
❖ MacArthur Park Neighborhood Council

  W 6th Street

  S. Park View Street
  Wilshire Blvd.

  S. Alvarado Street
  W 7th Street

  Location Map

Maintenance and Operational Challenges

Current Park Conditions
  ❖ Trash, debris, and graffiti require regular removal
  ❖ Some facilities need repair or replacement
  ❖ Green spaces need landscape maintenance &
  restoration
  ❖ Connecting tunnel requires cleaning, repairs, and
  improved access
  ❖ Current conditions make routine maintenance more  Water features unable to be
  difficult  regularly cleaned

  Trash and
  debris

  Facilities unable to be  Graffiti covering artists’
  maintained  murals

Fencing Project Goals

❖ Support long-term maintenance and repairs
❖ Improve cleanliness and upkeep
❖ Preserve accessibility and visibility
❖ Enhance park experience for families
  and visitors
❖ Support safe and reliable park operations

Fencing Project Scope of Work

Phase 1
❖ Install green metal fence around the
  perimeter of the Park
❖ Park to remain open during construction

Phase 2
❖ Addition of aesthetic design elements
❖ Community input guides design choices

Phase 1 – Install Perimeter Fence

❖ Preliminary green metal
  fence design
❖ Designed to maintain
  visibility into the park
❖ Fence height will be approx.
  8 feet

Similar Fence Design at MacArthur Park & Around the City
Examples of similar aesthetic fence designs – these can be seen throughout LA!

  MacArthur Park Existing Fence at 6th

Phase 2 – Addition of Aesthetic Elements
Community engagement opportunities
will help guide aesthetic design elements

Proposed Park Access

 ❖ Pedestrian Access

 ❖ Maintenance Vehicles Access

 ❖ Emergency Vehicles Access

Anticipated Construction Schedule

 Phase 1 - Installation of the Perimeter Fence
 November 2026 – Spring 2027

 Phase 2 - Installation of Aesthetic Fence Elements
 Fall/Winter 2027

 ❖ Park will remain open during construction
 ❖ Schedule is subject to change

Rec & Parks - Recent Improvements and Maintenance

 ❖ Various turf installation and signage updates in the Park
 ❖ LED lighting fixture upgrades and security camera installation
 ❖ Restroom improvements
 ❖ Replacement of playground and surfacing, and addition of fencing
 ❖ Gymnasium improvements

Recreational Programming

Park Enhancements & Upgrades
 ❖  Restore connecting tunnel access
 ❖  Accessibility improvements
 ❖  Free Wifi for Park-goers
 ❖  Replacement of all non-historic lights with solar lights
 ❖  Landscape improvements throughout the park
 ❖  Irrigation infrastructure repair/replacement
 ❖  Improvements informed by community feedback

Recreational Programming
 ❖  Run/Walk Events
 ❖  Movies in the Park
 ❖  Sports & Fitness Classes  Get Involved!
 ❖  Quarterly Community Events  Attend the Park Advisory Board meetings held on the
 ❖  Pedal Boats  third Monday of each month at 5 p.m.

Rec & Parks - Additional Improvement Projects

 Safe Clean Water: MacArthur Park
 Project

  ❖ Installation of underground water-treatment
  system around the park to safely clean and
  collect street runoff and stormwater
  ❖ Cleaned water will be used to keep Lake full
  ❖ New cascading water feature, pedestrian
  bridge, and native landscaping
  ❖ Starting construction Spring 2027
